purpose: Resolve the architecture uncertainty for the next request_context experiment: whether the observed context signal is likely to transfer with the fixed additive scorer or requires explicit interactions, while preserving impression-time availability and temporal evaluation.
query: Context-aware recommender ranking models using impression-time context such as time of day, weekday, and surface or tab; compare additive feature effects with user-item-context interaction models and report within-user ranking metrics, especially GAUC and nDCG@5.

purpose: Resolve whether a future scarce experiment should target the severe rare-item and weak-tab ranking gaps, and identify ranking or robustness methods that improve these slices without relying on unavailable outcomes, aggregate snapshots, or changes to the fixed evaluation.
query: Recommendation ranking methods for long-tail and rare-item exposure under implicit feedback, including pairwise or listwise objectives, popularity bias, and cold-start evaluation on logged impressions; emphasize methods compatible with fixed candidate rows and temporal holdouts.
